verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies a Linux software stack. The DGX B200 guide lists nvidia-smi, Docker Engine and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and a community hands-on report virtualizes HGX B200 GPUs using Fabric Manager and VFIO passthrough, which are Linux-hosted tooling. Nothing in the pack explicitly names Linux or documents a Linux driver release for this part. Missing for 10: explicit documented Linux driver releases/versions for B200, explicit statement of Linux OS support, independent Linux benchmarking or testing of the B200.
